scope: Fresh synthetic current-user document and workbook; private live read contracts followed by independent local fixtures. No provider/model calls.

privacy.creation_default: Previously observed invited-only private root default

read_observations.markdown_full: Native renders heading, bold, link, Unicode, table separator |-|-| and fenced code; fetched from actual native state after synthetic append.

xml_scopes.outline: fragment mode=outline containing outline and h1 with native id
xml_scopes.keyword: literal bold: fragment mode=keyword keyword=bold containing matching paragraph
xml_scopes.range: inclusive equal heading endpoints: fragment mode=range requested-end/requested-start and one h1
xml_scopes.section: heading through trailing paragraph, table and code: fragment mode=section requested-start

sheets_inspection.structure: A1:E1: row 1 auto height27; A:E default width105; no hidden, merged or grouped dimensions; integer revision
sheets_inspection.csv: A1:E1: annotated row prefix, formatted scalars; explicit row/column coordinates; no more rows; current_region and integer revision

read_observations.typed_success_requires: Complete signed raw reads plus explicit formula observation at matching integer revision and independent exact typed artifact; display/inspection alone never establishes success.

remaining_limits: Only the declared synthetic rich content subset is parsed for native creation; unknown valid syntax is unsupported.
Scoped Markdown and XML keyword OR/context/depth variants have not been observed and remain unsupported.
Sheets narrowed/alternate structure categories and truncated CSV inspection remain unsupported.
Fixture read outputs are a bounded service model, not byte-for-byte native layout/style serialization for arbitrary documents.
Historical report and 72 outcomes remain immutable; these contracts require a new balanced evaluator condition.
Native table XML remains the existing bounded simplified table representation; widths, header containers and nested paragraph IDs are not byte-for-byte serialization claims.
Keyword case-insensitive substring follows docs_fetch_v2.go flag contract; no match requiring normalization/regex fallback, or table/code matching, remains unsupported.
Only explicit A1:E1 structure/CSV range was observed; omitted inspection range remains unsupported.
